mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 5 consecutive quarters of GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in UNRATE above 7.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during UNRATE above 7.5% periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and fall in INDPRO (supply) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to tight labor market pressures.
failure_condition: Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 3-month window when the signal occurs.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'monetary tightening cycle', a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.0% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during tightening periods outside the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor participation) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 4 out of 5 consecutive months of PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly fall in INDPRO below 98.5 predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to weakening economic growth.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during INDPRO below 98.5 periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in FEDFUNDS coupled with a decline in GDPC1 predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to conflicting signals of economic contraction.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the interaction period.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'low unemployment regime' (UNRATE below 5%), a rise in UNRATE above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during UNRATE above 4.5% in low unemployment periods.
